task: Predict T stage group in non-small cell lung cancer. Classes: Low_T vs. High_T, representing lower versus higher primary tumor extent. Useful H&E cues include degree of local invasion, pleural involvement, destructive growth into surrounding tissue, and overall tumor bulk.

classes.0: Low_T tumor with more limited local invasion and a relatively confined primary lesion.
classes.1: High_T tumor with broader invasive spread, pleural or adjacent tissue involvement, and more locally advanced morphology.
